how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-mulgore-01-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:748:obj:0: Bring 6 ⟦E1⟧ Paws and 4 ⟦E2⟧ Talons to ⟦E3⟧ in Bloodhoof.
rows.quest:748:details:0: Goblins and their servants have tainted our sacred water wells! We cannot allow this.
rows.quest:748:details:1: To cleanse each well, I must create a cleansing totem, then you must bring the totem to the well and perform a cleansing ritual.
rows.quest:748:details:2: First we will create a cleansing totem for the Winterhoof Water Well. To do this, the land must offer its aid. Hunt prairie wolves for their paws and adult plainstriders for their talons. They are to the southwest.
rows.quest:748:details:3: Return to me with the paws and talons, ⟦1⟧.
rows.quest:748:progress:0: Do you have the paws and talons, ⟦2⟧?
rows.quest:748:completion:0: You have done well, ⟦3⟧. I will take these and bind their power into a totem of cleansing.
rows.quest:96130:title: Chakuyak
rows.quest:754:obj:0: Use the ⟦E6⟧ at the Winterhoof Water Well, then return to ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:754:details:0: I have crafted the totem to cleanse the Winterhoof Water Well. Now, you must take it to the well and perform a cleansing ritual. You will find it to the southeast, guarded by foul goblins!
rows.quest:754:details:1: This will not be an easy task, but you must do it if we are ever to use its waters again.
rows.quest:754:progress:0: Do not delay, ⟦5⟧.  The Winterhoof Well's taint must be removed!
rows.quest:754:completion:0: News of your deed reached me moments ago -- already the beasts near the well drink from it eagerly.
rows.quest:754:completion:1: You have done a great thing for the land, ⟦6⟧. And you have done a great thing for the Tauren people.
rows.quest:761:obj:0: Bring 8 Trophy ⟦E8⟧ Quills to ⟦E9⟧ in Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:761:details:0: The swoop is a cunning bird, and difficult to find and hunt. A collection of ⟦E8⟧ Quills is a badge of cleverness and determination for a hunter.
rows.quest:761:details:1: If you are willing to take up this task, then enter the plains and hunt the swoop.
rows.quest:761:details:2: Bring me their quills, and bring honor to your clan.
rows.quest:761:details:3: The swoops may be found anywhere in ⟦E10⟧, but your eyes must be sharp to spot them, and your hooves must be quick to catch them.
rows.quest:761:progress:0: Have you found the swoops, ⟦7⟧.  Do you have their quills?
rows.quest:761:completion:0: I know that gathering these quills was not an easy task, ⟦8⟧. In doing this, you prove that you are a ⟦9⟧ of merit. It is good to have you at Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:767:details:0: The ⟦E12⟧, one of the ⟦E13⟧, will help guide you toward earning the respect of the elders of ⟦E14⟧.
rows.quest:767:details:1: Our people have learned that the land is our most holy provider. In order to take part in the ritualistic vision, you must speak with the spiritual leader of the village, ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:767:completion:0: I sensed you would be coming to me, ⟦10⟧. I can always recognize one who is trying to pass the ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:99108:title: Sparring Match
rows.quest:99108:obj:0: Defeat 3 other players in duels or Novice Warriors for Tang Stonehoof.
rows.quest:756:details:0: To create the ⟦E17⟧, you must gather the claws of the predators of the ⟦E10⟧ plains. Hunt prairie stalkers for their stalker claws and flatland cougars for their cougar claws, then return to me.
rows.quest:756:details:1: You will find the prairie stalkers and flatland cougars to the east and west.
rows.quest:756:progress:0: ⟦11⟧, do you have the claws I sent you to gather? The Thunderhorn Water Well grows more tainted with each passing hour!
rows.quest:756:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦12⟧. The purity with which these beasts hunt is vital in the creation of the next cleansing totem.
rows.quest:756:completion:1: The goblins will never learn the difference between contending with the land, and living in harmony with it.
rows.quest:771:obj:0: Collect 2 Well Stones and 2 ⟦E18⟧ and bring them back to ⟦E11⟧ in Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:771:details:0: In order to pass through the ⟦E12⟧, you must gather the reagents needed to make the ⟦E19⟧.
rows.quest:771:details:1: I will need well stones, which can be found around the water wells in ⟦E10⟧. With those I will combine ⟦E18⟧, which fall beneath the mighty trees in our land.
rows.quest:771:details:2: These reagents contain magical elements, and when brewed and consumed before the tribal fire, will cause you to encounter a vision. Follow it, and it will lead you to the next step of this holy quest.
rows.quest:771:progress:0: Once you have gathered enough well stones from around the water wells and ⟦E18⟧ from beneath the trees, I will prepare the ⟦E19⟧ for you.
rows.quest:771:completion:0: I see you have learned to gather from our sacred land, ⟦13⟧. It will take but a moment for me to brew the ⟦E19⟧.
rows.quest:772:obj:0: Consume the ⟦E19⟧ in front of the tribal fire in Bloodhoof Village and follow the vision once it appears.
rows.quest:772:details:0: I now present you with the ⟦E19⟧.
rows.quest:772:details:1: When you are ready, consume the waters near the tribal fire. Once you have ingested the holy waters, it will take a few moments before the vision materializes before the fire.
rows.quest:772:details:2: At that point, it is up to you to follow it to your destiny....
rows.quest:772:completion:0: Be not afraid, ⟦14⟧. You have successfully passed the ⟦E12⟧.
rows.quest:743:obj:0: Bring 8 Windfury Talons to ⟦E20⟧ in Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:743:details:0: Thank you for taking the time to speak to me, ⟦15⟧. I am Ruul, warrior and teacher.
rows.quest:743:details:1: You have obviously reached an age when you must prepare for your trials if you are to adventure much further out of ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:743:details:2: If you wish a test of your strength, start by seeking out the Windfury harpies to the southeast. They nestle along the mountain's edges away from the road.
rows.quest:743:details:3: They are one of our natural enemies here in ⟦E10⟧ and will be a good gauge of your skill.
rows.quest:743:progress:0: The Windfuries are deadly foes. Their strength in battle is only rivaled by their desire for fresh meat.
rows.quest:743:completion:0: You have done well, ⟦16⟧. You seem well prepared to travel onward. Let the wind always be at your back.
rows.quest:745:obj:0: Kill 10 Palemane Tanners, 8 Palemane Skinners, and 5 Palemane Poachers, then return to ⟦E23⟧ in Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:745:details:0: ⟦17⟧, there are many conflicts that wound this land. It is my hope that you will not bear witness to as many of them as I have. Yet there is one that I would ask you to seek out. It will give you some sense of how terrible, if left unchecked, even a small threat can be to the land.
rows.quest:745:details:1: Palemane gnolls have settled to the south of Bloodhoof and in a cave to the west. They disrespect our attempts to communicate with them, and they slay the wildlife of ⟦E10⟧ unbridled.
rows.quest:745:details:2: Words are no longer the answer.
rows.quest:745:progress:0: If the Palemanes had respected the land and its inhabitants more, this conflict would have never occurred.
rows.quest:745:completion:0: ⟦18⟧, it is good you've taken my task seriously. Respect of the land and its creatures is important. Death and life are a circle... a necessity. One cannot exist without the other. Take time to ponder this and do well to never forget it.
rows.quest:746:obj:1: At a forge, smash the Prospector's Picks to create ⟦E26⟧.
rows.quest:746:details:0: There are dwarves preparing a dig site to the northwest. They think secrets lie in the earth, and that is true, but hollowing and defiling the land is no way to earn its teachings.
rows.quest:746:details:1: Collect the dwarven tools of digging, smash them, and return to me with the dwarves' broken tools.
rows.quest:746:details:2: You can smash the tools at a forge. You will find one in ⟦E14⟧, but any forge -- even a forge at the dwarven camp -- will suffice.
rows.quest:746:progress:0: Hello, ⟦19⟧.  Do you have the ⟦E26⟧?  The dwarves' digging will enrage the kodos of ⟦E10⟧.  This defilement must be stopped!
rows.quest:746:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦20⟧. This will calm the beasts of ⟦E10⟧. And, spirits willing, it will teach the dwarves that hollowing the land is not the path to knowledge.
rows.quest:749:obj:0: ⟦E27⟧ wants you to examine the contents of a supply crate at the Ravaged Caravan.
rows.quest:749:details:0: A few days ago, we found a Venture Co. caravan traveling under guard on the northern shore of Stonebull Lake. We'd lost two of our number in an earlier battle, so we were quick to attack and lay waste to the caravan.
rows.quest:749:details:1: We left their supply crates, thinking that our torches would destroy anything of value, but given that Venture Co. salvagers have been spotted near the burned wagons, maybe we were wrong.
rows.quest:749:details:2: Perhaps you could go to the caravan and examine the contents of the crates.
rows.quest:749:completion:0: All sides of the crate are stamped with the sign of the Venture Co. ⟦E28⟧ Division. Notes printed carefully on the side of the carton indicate that the contents are due for processing at one of their central plants.
rows.quest:751:obj:0: Return the ⟦E29⟧ to ⟦E27⟧ near Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:751:details:0: Prying open the lid reveals a tightly packed assortment of ore and minerals, more evidence of the Venture Co.'s mining operation in ⟦E10⟧. On the top of the ore and minerals you remove a tightly bound sheaf of papers.
rows.quest:751:details:1: Up in the foothills to the east, you can barely hear the sounds of work, and see smoke rising from a large fire.
rows.quest:751:progress:0: Hail, ⟦21⟧. Have you learned anything new about the Venture Co.'s plans and operations in our homeland?⟦22⟧⟦23⟧If they plan to exploit our lands as they have others, the Outrunners will be quick to put an end to it.
rows.quest:751:completion:0: It does indeed appear that the Venture Co. is attempting to rob us of our natural resources. It is good to know this for true, and now it seems, we must do something about it.
rows.quest:758:obj:0: Use the ⟦E17⟧ at the Thunderhorn Water Well, then return to Mull.
rows.quest:758:details:0: The totem is ready, ⟦24⟧. And again, it is your task to perform the ritual of cleansing.
rows.quest:758:details:1: Go to the Thunderhorn Water Well, north of the village, and use the ⟦E17⟧ in your ritual. After you do this, return to me.
rows.quest:758:progress:0: The Thunderhorn Water Well is still tainted, ⟦25⟧.  Please, you must perform the ritual!
rows.quest:758:completion:0: Ancestors of the Thunderhorn clan spoke to me in a dream, praising you for your actions near their well.
rows.quest:758:completion:1: For their gratitude, they wish to give you this...
rows.quest:766:obj:0: Bring a ⟦E30⟧, ⟦E31⟧, ⟦E32⟧ and ⟦E33⟧ to ⟦E34⟧ at Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:766:details:0: My grandfather told me stories about his battles with a strider named ⟦E35⟧. He told me of its demonic red eyes, razor-sharp talons and venomous bite.
rows.quest:766:details:1: As fortune would have it, while traveling across the plains, I encountered it, and it took a nasty bite from my shoulder. He was as terrible as my grandfather described. I will need some hard-to-find animal parts to clean the infection from his bite: a wolf heart, cougar femur, plainstrider scale and swoop gizzard.
rows.quest:766:details:2: Hurry, time is of the essence.
rows.quest:766:progress:0: My fever grows worse and I find my mind drifting into delirious nightmares... I should have known that I wouldn't be able to handle a beast my grandfather was unable to defeat...⟦26⟧⟦27⟧Do you have the ingredients for the remedy? I fear if I do not clean the infection soon, it will be the death of me.
rows.quest:766:completion:0: Ah, thank you, ⟦28⟧. Using the items you brought me, I will be able to create the remedy I need to stop the spread of the infection and, eventually, cure it completely. I owe you my life in thanks.
rows.quest:766:completion:1: But I'll never forget that screeching call when ⟦E35⟧ came upon me, the blaze of color as its beak descended...
rows.quest:99079:title: Longwalker Malah
rows.quest:99079:obj:0: Find Longwalker Malah Longwind east of Bloodhoof Village, near the edge of ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:99080:title: Drive Them Out
rows.quest:759:obj:0: Bring 8 Prairie Alpha Teeth to ⟦E3⟧ in Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:759:details:0: There is but one water well left to cleanse, named after the Wildmane clan. For this well to be pure, the land must offer the teeth of a fierce predator, the prairie wolf alpha. Find the alphas to the north, then return to me when your hunt is finished.
rows.quest:759:details:1: Alphas often wander around the base of our mighty city, ⟦E14⟧.
rows.quest:759:progress:0: ⟦29⟧. Do you have the teeth I asked for?
rows.quest:759:completion:0: Very good, ⟦30⟧. I can feel the sacrifice of the land in this offering, and my spirit swells with sadness, and pride.
rows.quest:760:obj:0: Use the ⟦E37⟧ at the Wildmane Water Well, then return to ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:760:details:0: Your cleansing of the Winterhoof and Thunderhorn wells is spoken among the spirits, young ⟦31⟧. The ⟦E38⟧ is made, and your last task lies ahead.
rows.quest:760:details:1: The Wildmane Water Well lies north of ⟦E14⟧. Perform the ritual! ⟦E39⟧ the land of the goblins' poisons! Let clean water flow once again!
rows.quest:760:progress:0: The last water well remains fetid and poisonous, ⟦32⟧.  You must not delay!
rows.quest:760:completion:0: You've done it. You have cleaned the wells, and healed our land. Bloodhoof village is grateful, ⟦33⟧.
rows.quest:760:completion:1: May the wind whisper your deeds for a hundred seasons, and may the waters of ⟦E10⟧ remain clean forever.
rows.quest:764:obj:0: Kill 14 Venture Co. Workers and 6 Venture Co. Supervisors for ⟦E27⟧ at Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:764:details:0: This explains the buildup of Venture Co. employees and equipment we've seen in ⟦E10⟧. Those goblins... their company is expanding too quickly for their own good. It's how they say, show a goblin something, and you can hear the scales in the background.
rows.quest:764:details:1: Greedy little things, they are. Unfortunately for their business enterprise, we tauren cannot allow them to conduct their operations in our lands. Go to their mine northeast of the ravaged caravan and send them a message.
rows.quest:764:progress:0: ⟦E40⟧ was refused mining rights here in ⟦E10⟧, but it would seem that they do not take no for an answer. We tauren are not ones to mince words, however, and we have other ways of getting our message across.
rows.quest:764:completion:0: I don't think there could be too much misinterpreting or ignoring of that signal, hm? ⟦E40⟧ will know not to take the tauren lightly, or to be so arrogant as to believe we would allow them to steal the natural resources around us without protest.
rows.quest:773:obj:0: ⟦E41⟧ to Red Rocks east of ⟦E14⟧ and speak with the ⟦E42⟧.
rows.quest:773:details:0: To gain acceptance amongst the elders of ⟦E14⟧ you must next complete the ⟦E43⟧.
rows.quest:773:details:1: Now that you have passed the ⟦E12⟧, the ancestral spirits of Red Rocks will give you the blessing of our ancestors. Only those who have drunk from the Water of Seers can gain the blessing.
rows.quest:773:details:2: ⟦E41⟧ east of ⟦E14⟧, to Red Rocks and seek out the ⟦E42⟧, ⟦34⟧.
rows.quest:773:completion:0: You have shown great diligence in your yearning to pass the ⟦E13⟧, ⟦35⟧.
rows.quest:773:completion:1: We, the Ancestral Spirits, represent the mighty tauren who gave their lives bravely to found and protect our great city of ⟦E14⟧. I hereby pass the duty of that protection over to you.
rows.quest:773:completion:2: You have passed the ⟦E43⟧, young ⟦36⟧. Enter ⟦E14⟧ with pride.
rows.quest:775:details:0: You will now be revered within our great city. Any ⟦37⟧ worthy of completing the ⟦E13⟧ earns that honor.
rows.quest:775:details:1: For your final quest, seek out our noble leader, ⟦E45⟧, who dwells atop the highest mesa in ⟦E14⟧.
rows.quest:775:completion:0: Hail, young ⟦38⟧. I see you found your way to my doorstep.
rows.quest:833:obj:0: ⟦E47⟧ wants you to kill 8 Bristleback Interlopers at Red Rocks.
rows.quest:833:details:0: Only the most valiant tauren are laid to rest at Red Rocks, our sacred burial ground. It is an honor bestowed upon the great warriors who helped found and defend ⟦E14⟧ and those who have given their lives for the greater good of their tribes and chieftains.
rows.quest:833:details:1: But it appears a foul menace has made its way onto our holy land. A band of Bristleback Interlopers is ravaging the grave site and I am too old and past my prime to drive them away.
rows.quest:833:details:2: They must be driven off with force, ⟦39⟧.
rows.quest:833:progress:0: The Bristleback Interlopers must be driven away from our sacred burial ground, ⟦40⟧.
rows.quest:833:completion:0: Well done. You have sent those foul Bristlebacks a clear message. They will think twice before attempting to meddle in this holy spot again.
rows.quest:861:details:0: You are eager to explore, I can tell. I too had the lust to wander, once...
rows.quest:861:details:1: Wander, and hunt. For hunting is a Tauren's greatest honor.
rows.quest:861:details:2: If you truly wish to follow the ways of the hunter, then ⟦E49⟧ can show you the path. He is in ⟦E14⟧, on the ⟦E50⟧'s Rise.
rows.quest:861:details:3: And to show him your skill and resolve, bring him the claws of the flatland prowlers of ⟦E10⟧. They are tough and cunning -- fitting prey for a young ⟦41⟧ on the hunter's path.
rows.quest:861:progress:0: Greetings. There is an air about you that tells me much. Do we have business, you and I?
rows.quest:861:completion:0: ⟦E51⟧ is a wise tauren. He has hunted for years and years, and although his body is old, his spirit burns fiercely. We are honored to have him with us.
rows.quest:861:completion:1: If Skorn sent you to me, then you too must have the hunter's spirit. And to have gathered these claws shows your burgeoning skills.
rows.quest:861:completion:2: Perhaps you are ready to walk the path.
rows.quest:765:obj:0: Kill ⟦E53⟧ and return his clipboard to ⟦E27⟧ at Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:765:details:0: According to the documents you salvaged from the caravan, the Venture Co. created many plans to attempt to drive us from our lands here, so that they could have free reign to plunder our lands.
rows.quest:765:details:1: The depths that they would sink to accomplish their goals disgusts and appalls me. I want the mastermind behind their plans killed. His name is ⟦E53⟧, you will find him at the Venture Co. mine east of the ravaged caravan. Bring me his clipboard, we shall see if we find out anything useful.
rows.quest:765:progress:0: I seethe with anger at the thought of the atrocities the Venture Co. is willing to perpetrate against us in the name of profit.
rows.quest:765:completion:0: My anger is somewhat lessened at the news that the villain Fizsprocket is dead. I will go through his personal effects and see if there is any additional information about what the Venture Co. has planned for the future. Thank you for your efforts, ⟦42⟧.
rows.quest:770:obj:0: Find someone who knows of Ghost Howl.
rows.quest:770:details:0: The ragged hide of Ghost Howl still bears a terrible wound, gained from the wolf's battles against the ⟦E54⟧.
rows.quest:770:details:1: Perhaps someone in Bloodhoof Village should know of Ghost Howl's demise....
rows.quest:770:completion:0: I can barely believe my old eyes! You defeated the great wolf Ghost Howl? I look upon you with new respect, young ⟦43⟧. You are a ⟦44⟧ of extreme skills!
rows.quest:770:completion:1: Let me offer you something. My days of hunting are over, but I would be honored if you used one of my weapons in your hunts.
rows.quest:770:completion:2: May it strike true, and bring you renown.
rows.quest:770:completion:3: And let us hope that Ghost Howl's spirit has finally found peace.
rows.quest:854:obj:0: Speak with ⟦E56⟧ at the Crossroads in the ⟦E57⟧.
rows.quest:854:details:0: I have foreseen your arrival, young ⟦45⟧. Though perhaps you are not so young anymore.
rows.quest:854:details:1: I think that it is time for you to move deeper into this land. I can sense that you are destined for great things.
rows.quest:854:details:2: It is the Crossroads that you must seek out, for our lives with the orcs have become intertwined and they need assistance. Continue down this road towards the east and follow it north to the Crossroads. Find ⟦E56⟧ within its walls, he has the Earthmother's blessing.
rows.quest:854:completion:0: It is good to see that more of our ⟦46⟧ allies have come to assist us from as far away as ⟦E14⟧. Again, I welcome you.
rows.quest:95350:title: Welcome to ⟦E59⟧
rows.quest:95350:obj:0: ⟦E41⟧ to ⟦E60⟧ and speak with ⟦E61⟧ in the Valley of Wisdom.
rows.quest:776:obj:0: ⟦E45⟧ in ⟦E14⟧ wants you to bring him the ⟦E62⟧.
rows.quest:776:details:0: You have passed the ⟦E13⟧ and earned your place in ⟦E14⟧.
rows.quest:776:details:1: But in order to maintain the spot that you strived so hard to achieve, you must continue to prove your worth to your people.
rows.quest:776:details:2: We are hunters, ⟦47⟧. Down below in ⟦E10⟧ there is a mighty kodo named ⟦E63⟧. Show me your skills in the ways of tracking and hunting by bringing me the ⟦E62⟧.
rows.quest:776:completion:0: Well done! A fine kill that was.
rows.quest:776:completion:1: I will send a gathering party to collect the carcass so we can retrieve the hide and meat.
rows.quest:776:completion:2: You have done a great deed for your people, ⟦48⟧.
